title: OpenAI appoints Denise Dresser as Chief Revenue Officer
summary_lines: Denise Dresser is joining as Chief Revenue Officer, overseeing OpenAI’s global revenue strategy across enterprise and customer success. She will help more businesses put AI to work in their day-to-day operations as OpenAI continues to scale.
